chapter: Paris scene and a visit home, 1937-39
title: The Hot Club of France and Django Reinhardt
summary: A gypsy band with Django played at the club while Butler's band rested; Django arrived with relatives some nights, and the French bassist was Vola.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: They just start out with nothing. No nothing, just start out. Anything in their head. Now, this was the Hot Club of France was there. Now, we had the gypsy band in there playing while we rested. Django was in the gypsy band. Now, Django was playing all that stuff when he

would come to work, and he would come to work, he would have about seven cousins or relatives, or something, they'd all be there and then, one night, you don't see nobody there. Then one night you would see Tango in there by himself and the French fellow who played the bass was called Vola.
